analysis.title: US Single Stock Volatility Chartbook
key_insights: Weekly JPM Global Equity Derivatives screens covering 336 liquid Russell 1000 members, with data as of Nov 16, 2026. They cover call overwriting and buying, put underwriting and buying, rich and cheap implied volatility, top and bottom implied volatility movers, options leverage and range bound versus trending names.

Call overwrite candidates, where sell signals outnumber buy signals and vol is rich, are COST, EW, SPG, CAH, SBUX, INTU, GILD, VRTX, ULTA and SPB. These are mostly recent winners with 14D RSI above 70 for COST, EW, SPG, CAH and EW. COST RSI is 77.1 and EW RSI is 80.1.

Call buying candidates, where buy signals outnumber sell signals and vol is cheap, are TEAM, DDOG, GLW, COIN, INTC, AXON, MU, FTNT, PLTR and WDC. All are down 18% to 42% over 1M with 14D RSI between 28.0 and 38.0. Their 3M 105 call premiums run 8.2% to 12.8% of spot.

Put underwriting candidates, where buy signals outnumber sell signals and vol is rich, are NVDA, VLO, PLUG, TXN, SNOW, QS, KLAC, CDNS, DOW and ZS. NVDA is down 28.7% over 1M with RSI at 22.7. Its 3M 95 put premium is 7.5% at 53.3 IV.

Put buying candidates, where sell signals outnumber buy signals and vol is cheap, are CMG, IDXX, KHC, POOL, CPRI, SMG, TTD, MCD, UPS and MRNA. Most have rallied over 1M, including IDXX +35.3%, POOL +34.6% and CPRI +41.6%. MRNA is up 250.9% over 3M but sits 54.3% below its JPM price target.

Richest implied volatility scores (above 75% is rich) are led by CZR, UNH, PNC, NKE, LYV, COF, VRTX, APD, COST and RIVN, with CZR at 100.0 and UNH at 99.9. Cheapest scores (below 25% is cheap) are led by IBM, DKS, CACC, TMUS, ALNY, PYPL, CHRW, CMG, FIS and TDOC, with IBM at 0.3.

Largest 1W gains in 3M ATM implied vol are KLAC +7.1 pts, CACC +6.3, TEAM +6.0, INTC +5.6, PLTR +5.2, MU +5.1 and HOOD +5.0. Largest drops are CSCO -3.8 pts, SRPT -3.7, KMX -3.7, MCHP -3.3 and TDOC -3.1.

Options leverage screen: the highest put to call premium ratios, meaning upside calls obtainable per downside put sold, are NLY and AGNC at 1.9, PGR at 1.6, PRU at 1.4 and a group at 1.3 including HON, COST and WM. The bearish call to put ratio list is led by DLR, BBWI, MCHP and NKE at 0.9.

Range bound screen: trending names with scores above 125% include INTC (237%), AXON (228%), PLUG (185%), NLY (175%) and ALNY (168%). The most range bound names include AMZN (38%), ROST (39%), THC (44%) and TGT (44%) and are the best option sale candidates.

Scheduled earnings flagged in the screens: NVDA reports Nov 17, TGT Nov 18, INTU and ROST Nov 19. NVDA is on the put underwriting list, INTU on the call overwrite list, and TGT and ROST are among the most range bound names.

Several screen names trade far from JPM price targets. Upside to target is MU +97.9%, WDC +119.9%, AXON +93.4%, PLUG +147.7% and ALNY +123.6%. MRNA is -54.3% and CLX is -21.4%, so the target signal pushes in opposite directions across screens.

risk_factors: Option pricing in the report is indicative only and not a tradable level.
Call sale (uncovered) carries theoretically unlimited upside risk and put sale carries exposure down to zero.
Buyers of calls or puts risk losing 100% of the premium paid.
The screens use technical and estimate-revision signals that can conflict. FTNT is Underweight but flagged for call buying and MRNA is 54.3% above target yet flagged for put buying.
charts_described: Scatter of 1W stock price change against 1W change in 3M ATM implied vol for the top 20 movers, with KLAC the highest at +7.1 pts and the axis running to 8.0.
Scatter of 3M range bound score against 3M ATM implied vol for 20 trending and 20 rangebound names, with trending scores up to 250% and rangebound scores up to 60%.
Price charts for COST, EW, TEAM and DDOG show price, JPM or Bloomberg target and the 105% call breakeven from Dec-24 to Aug-26. Similar charts show NVDA, VLO, CMG and IDXX with the 95% put breakeven.
vol_and_positioning: Cheap vol is defined as a volatility score below 25% and rich vol as above 75%. The score is the average of the 2Y percentile of 3M IV/RV versus the S&P 500 and the 2Y percentile of 3M IV/RV sector relative.
Richest vol names: CZR 100.0, UNH 99.9, PNC 99.7, NKE 98.7, LYV 98.2, COF 98.1. Cheapest: IBM 0.3, DKS 0.4, CACC 1.0, TMUS 1.3, ALNY 1.4, PYPL 1.5.
DKS has 3M ATM implied vol of 50.5 against realized vol of 89.2. CACC has 34.4 against 55.4, TDOC has 59.7 against 69.5 and NOW has 54.3 against 82.6, so implied is below realized in the cheap list.
KLAC 3M ATM implied vol rose 7.1 pts to 67.5 while the stock gained 0.6%, a vol rise with flat price. INTC rose 5.6 pts to 71.5 against 100.7 realized.
Implied vol fell for CSCO (-3.8 pts to 38.2) and SRPT (-3.7 pts to 78.9), with the stock down 6.8% for SRPT.
Skew screen: NLY and AGNC offer 1.9 upside calls per downside put sold, PGR 1.6, PRU 1.4. On the bearish side the call to put premium ratio tops out at 0.9 for DLR, BBWI, MCHP, NKE and MS.

Range bound score is the 3M high-low range divided by the range implied by 3M IV, using 1.6 x price x IV x sqrt(T). Above 125% means the stock moved more than options implied, below 75% means less and favors selling options.
Most range bound: AMZN 38%, ROST 39%, THC 44%, TGT 44%, VRTX 47%, MET 47%, LYV 48%. Most trending: INTC 237%, AXON 228%, PLUG 185%, NLY 175%, ALNY 168%.
Chip and software names show large 1W implied vol gains alongside price moves. MU +5.1 pts with the stock +6.2%, AVGO +4.0 pts with +8.6%, AMD +4.8 pts with +5.0%, RIVN +4.7 pts with -13.1%.
